internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across almost the whole packet, س ل م contributes the idea of a thing being WHOLE and unbreached — free of harm, flaw, or division — and, when active, of that whole thing being handed over intact. The greeting/eschatological سَلَام cluster (10:10, 13:24, 19:15, 19:33, 37:79-181, 36:58, 56:26, 97:5, 6:54, 7:46, 16:32, 33:44, 39:73, 43:89, 50:34, 15:46, and the reticent قالوا سلاما of 11:69, 15:52, 25:63, 51:25) is 'wholeness/safety be upon you' — an unbreached state wished or realized. الله السَّلام (59:23) is the Flawless/Whole. دار/سبل السلام (6:127, 10:25, 5:16) is the destination of intactness. سَلِيم قلب (26:89, 37:84) and سالِمون (68:43) are the sound/unharmed self. On the transitive side, أسلم وجهه لله (2:112, 3:20, 4:125, 31:22, 6:14, 6:71, 40:66) and مُسْلِم / إسلام (the large N(IV)/PN(IV) mass) are giving one's whole self over intact to God; مُستسلمون (37:26) is that same giving-over in defeat; ألقوا السَّلم (16:28, 16:87, 4:90-91) is laying oneself/one's arms down whole; السِّلم/السَّلم (2:208, 8:61, 47:35) is entering an unbreached, non-hostile state. Form II carries the handing-over-intact sense literally: سلّمتم ما آتيتم 'you hand over in full' (2:233), دية مُسَلَّمة 'blood-money paid over entire' (4:92), بقرة مُسَلَّمة 'a cow sound/without blemish' (2:71), الله سَلَّم 'God kept whole/delivered' (8:43), and رجلاً سَلَمًا لرجل 'a man belonging wholly/undivided to one master' (39:29). تسليماً (4:65, 33:22, 33:56) is whole, unreserved submission. The same thread — intactness, or something rendered whole — runs through all of these.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: FORM is stripped first: Form IV (أسلم / مُسلم / إسلام) specializes the residue as 'give the whole self over to God' → conventionally 'submit'; Form X (استسلم, 37:26) is that giving-over under compulsion; Form II (سلّم) is the transitive 'render whole / hand over intact / convey salām'; ADJ(II) مُسَلَّمة is 'made-whole / handed-over'. CONSTRUCTION is stripped next: the fixed greeting frame سَلامٌ عَلى X, the surrender idiom ألقى/ألقوا السَّلم, and the genitive-of-destination دار/سبل السلام are formulaic vehicles, not extra root meaning. CONTEXT is stripped last: Paradise-greeting, the Abrahamic prophetic-submission narrative, and juristic handing-over (diyah 4:92, nursing-wage 2:233) supply the participants and scene. What remains in every stripped case is the bare residue 'unbreached wholeness / rendered whole' — EXCEPT the instrument-noun سُلَّم (فُعَّل pattern), where stripping the instrument form leaves only 'means of ascent', with no internal signal of the residue.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: سُلَّم 'ladder' at 6:35 (أو سُلَّمًا في السماء — 'or a ladder into the sky') and 52:38 (أم لهم سُلَّمٌ يستمعون فيه — 'or have they a ladder by which they eavesdrop'). Both are instrument nouns (فُعَّل) denoting a means of ascent to heaven. Nothing in either verse's internal evidence displays wholeness, soundness, safety, or handing-over; the only way to attach the candidate residue ('a means that conveys one up intact') is by importing external etymology, which the hard rules forbid as evidence. From internal Quranic evidence alone the residue is NOT demonstrably present here, so these two occurrences resist the proposed universal contribution.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: That the core is 'SUBMISSION / YIELDING' (an islām-centric reading). Rejected as the root residue: submission is only the Form IV/X projection ('give the whole self over'), and it fails wholesale for سَلِيم/سالِم (sound heart, unharmed), مُسَلَّمة (a blemish-free cow, blood-money paid in full), the سَلام greetings, and سُلَّم — none of which involve yielding. A second competitor, 'PEACE/SAFETY', likewise fails for أسلم وجهه (giving self, not peace), for سلّمتم/دية مسلمة (handing over, not peace), and for سُلَّم. 'Unbreached wholeness (static or rendered)' subsumes both competitors as form/context specializations and covers strictly more of the set — but still not سُلَّم.
internal_discovery.distinctiveness_note: The residue is falsifiable and distinct from nearest roots. vs أ م ن (amn = security against fear/trust): 15:46 pairs them — بسلامٍ آمنين — so intactness (slm) is held apart from felt security (amn). vs ص ل ح (ṣlḥ = becoming good / being repaired after corruption): slm is being/keeping whole and unbroken, not fixing what was broken (contrast السِّلم 8:61/47:35 with أصلح). vs خ ل ص (khlṣ = purity, freedom from admixture): slm is wholeness/undividedness, not unmixedness — sharply visible at 39:29, رجلاً سَلَمًا لرجل (undivided, wholly one owner's) opposed to a man شركاءُ متشاكسون (divided among quarrelers). The residue predicts: wherever slm appears, expect an unbreached-whole entity or a whole-thing-rendered; this holds for 138 occurrences and is violated only by the instrument سُلَّم.

internal_discovery.rationale: A single distinctive residue — unbreached wholeness / intactness, with its transitive projection 'render something whole' — is demonstrably present and load-bearing in 138 of 140 confirmed occurrences after subtracting Form (IV submit, X surrender, II hand-over/greet), Construction (سلامٌ على, ألقى السلم, دار السلام), and Context. It cleanly separates from amn, ṣlḥ, and khlṣ and correctly recasts the popular 'submission' and 'peace' glosses as derived specializations. However, the non-negotiable unity rule forbids a majority verdict: the two instrument-noun occurrences سُلَّم 'ladder' (6:35, 52:38) do not exhibit the residue on internal evidence alone, and reconciling them requires external etymology that the packet rules exclude. Because even one confirmed occurrence (here, two) cannot be reconciled from cited verse evidence, UNIVERSAL PRESENCE does not hold and the honest result is UNRESOLVED — recorded, not forced. Strength is MODERATE rather than WEAK because the dominant contribution is strong, distinctive, and covers the overwhelming remainder; it is not STRONG because the residue's static/transitive duality leans on treating 'given-over-whole' as one facet, and the ladder anomaly is a genuine irreducible gap.

adversarial_verification.notes: Adversarial full-coverage check of all 140 confirmed occurrences. The proposed residue (unbreached wholeness/intactness + its dynamic projection of rendering-over-entire) is demonstrably present and distinctive across the overwhelming majority of the domain: (a) static soundness — qalb salim 26:89/37:84, baqarah musallamah 'no blemish in it' 2:71, salimun 68:43; (b) peace as freedom-from-breach — the salam greeting/abode family and al-Salam 59:23; (c) peace-vs-war silm/salm 2:208/8:61/47:35; (d) rendering-over entire — Form IV aslama wajhahu / muslim / islam, alqaw al-salam (surrender) 16:28/16:87/4:90-94, Form II sallama 'hand over payment' 2:233, diyah musallamah 4:92, sallama 'delivered/kept safe' 8:43, mustaslimun 37:26; (e) rajulan salaman 39:29 = belonging wholly/undividedly to one master. Distinctiveness holds where present (vs amn=security-from-fear the residue is wholeness/freedom-from-defect; vs khadaea/qanata the 'given up entire' projection is distinctive), so distinctiveness_ok=true. The claim is falsifiable and IS falsified: the concrete noun sullam='ladder' (52:38, 6:35) is a confirmed root occurrence where, from the cited verse text alone, only 'instrument of ascent/climbing' is demonstrable. Neither unbreached wholeness nor rendering-over-whole can be shown without importing etymology, which is barred as evidence. Under non-negotiable root unity, these two unreconciled occurrences mean universal presence does NOT hold, hence verdict != SUPPORTED. It is not a full REFUTED because the residue is genuinely present and distinctive across every other cluster; the failure is isolated to the sullam ('ladder') lexical sub-family. سُلَّم 'ladder' (fuʿʿal instrument noun) was flagged because the static face of the residue ('soundness') seems alien to it, but the frozen contribution explicitly includes a transitive face: rendering something over in its whole, intact state. A ladder is the instrument of exactly that — the device that yuslimu (renders over, intact) the climber to an otherwise unreachable level; classical lexica derive it precisely so (سُمِّي سُلَّمًا لأنه يُسْلِمُك إلى حيث تريد), using the root's own Form IV verb attested elsewhere in the packet (أسلم وجهه لله). In 52:38 the construction (أم لهم سُلَّمٌ يستمعون فيه) uses the fully lexicalized noun purely instrumentally — a hypothetical means of being conveyed up to the exalted council — and activates nothing contrary to the residue. The anomalous fuʿʿal pattern and Semitic cognates (simmiltu/sullām) are a noted caveat but do not outweigh the direct, non-ad-hoc internal derivation; the contribution holds via its dynamic projection without forcing.

Separating form (lexicalized fuʿʿal instrument noun), derivation (from the residue's transitive face: that which hands the climber over whole and unbreached to the height — the classical يُسْلِمُك إلى derivation), construction (indefinite object of تبتغي, parallel to the tunnel as pure means-of-access), participants (the Prophet hypothetically seeking access), and context (neutral, no counter-signal): the frozen contribution surfaces frozen in the derivational path of the instrument noun, as expected for a fully lexicalized concrete noun, and nothing in the verse strains it.
